candidates.name: Ordergroove
candidates.description: Ordergroove enables subscription and membership experiences for the world’s largest and most innovative brands, including L’Oréal, Dollar Shave Club, Petsmart, La Colombe Coffee, and The Honest Company. As a market leader in subscription technology, our proprietary Relationship Commerce platform is shifting consumer interactions from one-and-done transactions to frictionless and highly profitable recurring relationships. Ordergroove technology uses artificial intelligence, analytics, and unmatched consumer expertise to empower top brands to transform their commerce experiences while making their consumers’ lives easier.
candidates.rationale: Same subscription commerce/billing category for DTC brands; strong overlap in buyer persona and product use case.

candidates.name: Stay AI
candidates.description: Stay AI is the subscription management app that helps DTC brands on Shopify supercharge their growth. Elevate your subscription programs with innovative, new-to-market features to optimize for LTV and reduce churn with Stay. 🚀 Power any type of subscription program — from trials, to dynamic bundles, to prepaid — with frictionless subscriber touch points. 📈 Boost growth and reduce churn with our proprietary ExperienceEngine, an experience builder delivering rewards and upsells with AI-powered personalization and comprehensive A/B testing. 📉 Reduce subscriber churn by 30% more than any other available solution with RetentionEngine, which delivers the most advanced passive and active churn reduction tools leveraging proprietary AI to improve outcomes. We offer seamless, white-glove migration so you can make the switch from other subscription apps with ease. Reach out for a personalized demo today, and find out why top brands like Vita Coco, Olipop, Bright Cellars, and hundreds more choose Stay.
candidates.rationale: Same Shopify DTC subscription billing/management category and similar merchant customers; clear direct lookalike to Recharge.

candidates.name: Skio
candidates.description: Skio (a Recharge company) is subscription management software for brands on Shopify. Customers include Gruns, Neuro Gum, Instant Hydration, IM8, and more.
candidates.rationale: Direct competitor in Shopify subscription management for DTC brands; same buyer, model, and customer base.

candidates.name: Loop Subscriptions
candidates.description: Loop Subscriptions helps you grow, manage, and retain subscribers like a Pro. candidates.rationale: Same subscription billing/lifecycle platform for DTC Shopify merchants; overlapping customer base, product category, and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Cleeng
candidates.description: Cleeng unifies the entire subscriber experience across web and mobile apps from a single platform, empowering D2C companies to simplify subscription management and maximize customer lifetime value. Our award-winning Subscriber Retention Management® suite delivers comprehensive solutions through an integrated approach - from flexible web payments and in-app subscriptions to sophisticated recurring billing and AI-powered customer support. Trusted by industry leaders, including Big Ten Network, The Weather Channel, TOD/BeIN, Tennis Channel and NHK, Cleeng's complete suite helps businesses reduce churn and drive sustainable revenue growth across every channel. Experience streamlined subscription management that evolves with your business needs.

candidates.name: Nexway
candidates.description: Rapidly transform, grow, and scale your online business With over two decades of experience, Nexway is a global eCommerce and payment solutions provider specializing in digital monetization for medium-sized and large enterprises through uncovering new opportunities for rapid global expansion. With Nexway, combine ALL eCommerce fundamentals for success Nexway handles the complexity of online sales and covers the full scope of eCommerce aspects to help businesses optimize their online sales and revenue streams. From worldwide accepting payment to subscription handling and tax management, leverage time and money while scaling your business into the global market. The company's clients include Kaspersky, ESET, Bitdefender, Opera, and many more companies across the globe. Nexway is headquartered in France, with offices in the US, Japan, and Italy.
candidates.rationale: Nexway is a broader eCommerce/payment provider for enterprise digital monetization, not a Shopify DTC subscription billing peer.

candidates.name: MagnaQuest
candidates.description: Magnaquest is a trusted provider of cutting-edge subscription management solutions. We specialize in simplifying complex billing processes, maximizing subscriber retention, and driving revenue growth for businesses across diverse industries.
candidates.rationale: Subscription management and billing platform with similar customer need and software model, though broader vertical focus than Recharge.

candidates.name: Dsb
candidates.description: Wir bieten über 50 Jahre Verlagsexpertise, gepaart mit Digital-Know-how. Unsere Customer-Care- und Billing-Plattform verarbeitet flexibel unterschiedlichste Paywall-Modelle. Durch datengetriebene Kampagnen sorgen wir für treffsicheren Smart Content, Conversion Boosting und Churn-Dezimierung. Zu unseren Kunden gehören internationale Brands aus der Verlags- und Medienvertriebsbranche. Neben dem SPIEGEL-Verlag, FUNKE direkt, Vogel Business Media und Future Publishing PLC setzen auch u.a. intan und Zenit X in puncto Abo-Management-Lösungen auf dsb ccb solutions. Die ccb suite bildet ganzheitliche Sales Prozesse für Digital- & Print-Content ohne Medienbrüche ab. Mit unserem Online Kundenservice können Ihre Leser und Leserinnen 24/7 Abos abschließen, Nachsendeaufträge starten oder Adressänderungen vornehmen. Ein vollautomatisierter Datenaustausch sorgt für geringe Prozesskosten und hohe Datenqualität. Unser gemeinsam mit Verlagsfachleuten entwickeltes Subscription Management Tool digitalisiert Ihre Prozesse. Zusätzlich entlasten wir Ihr Contact Center durch ein automatisiertes E-Mail-Management. Ob Lesezugriff mit dem Freemium oder Metered Modell, Digital-Abo, Bundle-Abo, Micro-Abo, Club-Modell oder Einzelproduktverkauf - unsere Customer-Care-Software ccb passt sich flexibel an Ihr Geschäftsmodell an. ccb verknüpft die Daten aus Shop, Customer Care, Billing, CRM & ERP. Die hohe Integrationsfähigkeit garantiert Firmen Investitionssicherheit für die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur. Unter der Dachmarke dsb firmieren rechtlich eigenständige Unternehmen (dsb ccb solutions, dsb ebusiness, dsb cloud services, dsb it services und dsb.net) mit unterschiedlichen Aufgabenschwerpunkten. Die Firmensitze der einzelnen Gesellschaften sind in Frankfurt am Main und in Neckarsulm. Impressum: https://www.dsb-ccb.de/de/impressum/ Datenschutz: https://www.dsb-ccb.de/de/datenschutz/
candidates.rationale: Different target market: Dsb serves media publishers with billing/paywall software, not Shopify DTC subscription merchants.

candidates.name: Bold Commerce
candidates.description: Bold Commerce builds powerful tools that help ecommerce brands grow smarter and sell more. With two powerhouse solutions, Bold Apps for Shopify and Bold Booster for open source platforms, we help brands unlock new revenue potential and drive performance across their storefronts. Our suite of Shopify Apps are designed to maximize revenue potential. With 760,000+ merchants worldwide and over a decade of experience, no one knows Shopify better than Bold. Sell more to every subscriber with Bold Subscriptions, the only subscriptions solution on Shopify designed to upsell at every subscriber touchpoint. Maximize AOV with high-converting AI-powered upsells and cross-sells from Bold Upsell. Power wholesale, VIP and customer-specific pricing with Bold Custom Pricing. Go further with Bold Memberships, Discounts, Bundles, QuickBooks Sync and Xero Sync. Bold Booster is purpose-built for open source platforms like Magento. It’s the quickest, simplest, and free way to unlock PayPal’s full potential, including Fastlane, Apple Pay, Venmo, Pay Later, and more. Designed to boost conversions with fewer clicks, Bold Booster delivers friction-free checkout, faster site speed, smarter fraud detection, and seamless compatibility with any Magento version. Whether you’re growing a Shopify business or optimizing your Magento storefront, Bold delivers the tools you need to turn browsers into buyers and boost your bottom line.
candidates.rationale: Both sell Shopify-focused subscription and ecommerce tools to DTC merchants; same buyer persona and overlapping product category.
